name: e2e-fixture-isolation
goal: Two browser runs at once, from one checkout or from different verification snapshots, each keep their own seeded history, report store, sites, analytics and results; no run reads or removes the fixtures of another

evidence: Independent browser run failed 9 of 112 while a verification ran from another snapshot on other ports (work/logs/stage-f-shared-fixture-RED-independent-browser.log): ENOENT /tmp/harness-console-e2e/meta.json and a record of another seeding. Root cause: every run seeded the same fixed directories (/tmp/harness-console-e2e, /tmp/project-reports-e2e, /tmp/alpha-project and nine more, /tmp/harness-reports-analytics-e2e) and adopted any server already on its ports. Prior behaviour held only while one run existed at a time.

test/reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts starts two real browser runs at once on separate free ports with the compiled server and observes them only through a shared TMPDIR. On the unchanged defaults it fails: work/logs/stage-f-concurrent-runs-red.log, Timed out after 180 s waiting for the first run to seed a history of its own.

One module (packages/reports/src/utils/e2eFixtures.ts) gives each run a directory under the system temporary directory and free ports unless the caller names them, exports both through the environment to its servers, seeds and specs, removes the directory in a global teardown only when that process made it, and adopts a running server only when the caller named the directory. Guard: the same concurrent test in the package suite.

Playwright configuration, the three seed scripts, the analytics seeder, the history helper and seventeen specs take every path from the run; HARNESS_CONSOLE_E2E_HOME, HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME and the port variables still place those parts explicitly and HARNESS_E2E_ROOT names a kept directory. The picker preview takes a free port under verification and test/cli.e2e.test.ts no longer uses port 43321. The test is in test:package, part of bun run check.

work/logs/stage-f-concurrent-runs-green-3.log: 1 passed in 76 s: two histories with different commits, media and metadata of the longer run unchanged through the teardown of the shorter, both runs green, both directories removed by their own run. Changes to the test after red are listed in work/logs/stage-f-test-diff.log.

In the scratch clone /tmp/harness-self-f/repo of the frozen tree 1af9e1de: with openE2eRun returning one shared directory the test fails (work/logs/stage-f-concurrent-runs-guard-red.log, Timed out waiting for both runs to seed a history each); restored, it passes in 86 s (stage-f-concurrent-runs-guard-green.log).

Full bun run check exit 0 with the test in test:package (work/logs/stage-f-check-3.log: 442 unit, 175 CLI end-to-end, 25 package, 114 reports unit tests); complete reports browser suite 114 passed, 1 env-gated skip, picker 1 passed, no fixture directory left behind (stage-f-test-e2e-final-2.log). No UI changed for this repair.
